bodySupportKnots: Actual legacy admission/constructor/Direct support loop visits; zero does not include new job metrics.
bodyLengthInputs: Input edges passed to each real compactLength helper invocation, not timing or a second content walk.
bodyCompileInputs: Actual source span lengths passed to legacy full/compiler append calls in the measured leaf.
preparedSupportKnots: New job actual support loop visits, <=32 source knots per advance.
preparedDistanceInputs: New job actual hypot edges, one traversal per unique body.
preparedCompileInputs: New job actual compiler append source input extents; synthetic bounded taper cuts are algorithm work, not source knots.
preparedPathPrimitives: Bounded emitted ribbon/cap processing including fused bounds/groups; <=32 units per advance.
preparedMaxAdvanceKnots: Maximum source extent of one metrics or compile advance; frozen bound32.
bodyReplayInputs: Actual visible checkpoint compiler append input extents; separate from unique cold preparation.
preparedCanonicalDraws: Actual ready body draw batches in CompactStrokeRasterJob, not a request/get counter.
preparedDirectDraws: Actual ready body tile draws in ordinary Direct/isolated/damage leaves.
preparedCanonicalQueries/preparedDirectQ: Lookup-only real consumer requests; paired with actual draw and real GPU-target counters for qualification.
preparedContentComparisons: Complete equality call count for previously unknown allocation; validation cost remains distinct from warm lookup and preparation.
preparedSourceFootprintEvaluations: Existing source sizing/validation call count, not claimed to be zero on unknown allocation.
